Check whether our Claude Covered Models (`Mythos 5` / `Fable 5`) and OpenAI `GPT-5` Mantle endpoints violate our Zero Data Retention requirements before go-live.
Calculate our real Claude Sonnet 4.5 TPM quota headroom accounting for the 5:1 output token burndown rate and `CacheReadInputTokenCount` exemptions.
Inspect all IAM roles and Organization SCPs in our account for wildcard `bedrock:*` / `bedrock-mantle:*` permissions ahead of our security sign-off.
Our CISO blocked our GenAI release until we prove provider data sharing is disabled, Bedrock runtime CloudTrail data events are on, and per-model TPM utilization won't throttle on launch day.
We use both Claude on `bedrock-runtime` and OpenAI models via `bedrock-mantle` — audit whether we meet `READY`, `READY WITH ACTIONS`, or `NOT READY` criteria.
Before flipping DNS to our new Bedrock clinical summarizer in Mumbai, verify IAM role wildcards, ZDR regime status, VPC endpoints, and throttle alarms.
Review our AgentCore Runtimes (`AC-RUN-1..4`), Gateways (`GW-01`), and Long-Term Memory ingestion error rates (`AC-MEM-1..4`) for operational hygiene.
Validate CloudWatch Transaction Search and AWS Lambda OpenTelemetry Layer wrapper variables for an AgentCore agent emitting zero X-Ray spans.
